caption: The drawing shows a landscape scene dominated by a river or body of water flowing horizontally across the center. On either side of the river, there are large clusters of vegetation, including trees, bushes, and tall, grassy plants. The trees and foliage are rendered in brown and greenish-brown tones, while the water is illustrated with lighter shades of yellow and brown, suggesting reflections. There are six birds depicted in the image: two flying low over the water, their wings outstretched; one bird standing at the water’s edge on the left; and three birds flying in the sky toward the top center of the drawing. The birds are colored in shades of pink with some light red accents. The background above the trees is filled with a flat expanse of yellow, while low hills or distant terrain in pale yellow and white are visible in the far distance. The overall palette consists primarily of yellow, brown, green, and pink-orange shades, with the composition balanced by dense foliage on both the left and right sides and open sky above.
title: Wall Paper
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
